author: musho7-dev
subject: Garage: split into separate Planets and Cars parts
body:
PLANETS / CARS switch at the top of the garage panel. Planets shows the
planet info, picture tiles and the daily run; Cars shows the car info,
car grid, Build your car and that car's upgrades. Coins, music and sound
stay at the top and DRIVE at the bottom.
